title: Minecraft Java Edition 1.18.1
author: Adrian Östergård
imageAltText: A view from down in a Dripstone Cave looking up towards a sun that is setting behind a snowcapped mountain.
description: Experience Minecraft Java Edition 1.18.1. This release fixes critical security issues and improves aspects of gameplay. Upgrade to this version today!

blocks.source_text: We’re now releasing Minecraft: Java Edition 1.18.1. This release fixes a critical security issue for multiplayer servers, changes how the world fog works to make more of the world visible, and fixes a couple of other bugs.
blocks.translated_text: 我们现已发布 Minecraft: Java 版 1.18.1。此版本修复了一个针对多人服务器的关键安全问题，改进了世界雾效的处理方式，使更多地形可见，并修复了其他一些漏洞。

blocks.source_text: If you are running a multiplayer server, we highly encourage you to upgrade to this version as soon as possible.
blocks.translated_text: 如果您正在运行多人服务器，我们强烈建议您尽快升级到此版本。

blocks.source_text: Enjoy!
<https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-18-1>Technical Changes in 1.18.1
Fixed an issue that would cause players on low-bandwidth connections to get timeout errors when connecting to a server
blocks.translated_text: 修复了一个问题：之前低带宽连接的玩家在尝试连接到服务器时会出现超时错误。

blocks.source_text: World fog now starts further away from the player, to make distant terrain more visible
blocks.translated_text: 世界雾效现在从玩家更远的位置开始生成，从而让远处的地形更加清晰可见。

blocks.source_text: Instead of applying fog as a spherical volume it is now applied as a cylindrical volume
blocks.translated_text: 雾效不再以球形体积的形式应用，而是改以圆柱形体积的形式应用。

blocks.source_text: <https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-18-1>Fixed bugs in 1.18.1
[MC-152198](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-152198)  - Actual render distance is 2 chunks lower than render distance setting
[MC-219507](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-219507)  - Beacon’s power reverts back to previous one on world reload
[MC-229321](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-229321)  - Bees inside of bee hives / nests sometimes despawn when the world is reloaded
[MC-242729](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-242729)  - “Observer activating without any updates nearby, caused by /clone”
[MC-243216](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-243216)  - Chunk render distance on servers seems shorter than in 1.17.1
[MC-243796](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-243796)  - Random non fatal exceptions in console: Failed to store chunk ConcurrentModificationException
blocks.translated_text: [MC-243796](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-243796) - 控制台出现随机非致命异常：尝试存储区块时发生 ConcurrentModificationException 错误

blocks.source_text: <https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-18-1>Get the Release
​To install the release, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/download) and click play!
blocks.translated_text: 要安装新版本，请打开 [Minecraft 启动器](https://www.minecraft.net/download)，然后点击 ‘开始游戏’(play)！

blocks.source_text: Cross-platform server jar:
[Minecraft server jar](https://launcher.mojang.com/v1/objects/125e5adf40c659fd3bce3e66e67a16bb49ecc1b9/server.jar)
Report bugs here:
[Minecraft issue tracker!](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary)
Want to give feedback?
Head over to our  [feedback website](https://feedback.minecraft.net/)  or come chat with us about it on the  [official Minecraft Discord](https://discord.gg/Minecraft) .
blocks.translated_text: 请访问我们的[反馈网站](https://feedback.minecraft.net/)，或在[官方 Minecraft Discord](https://discord.gg/Minecraft)上与我们讨论这些问题。

content:
We’re now releasing Minecraft: Java Edition 1.18.1. This release fixes a critical security issue for multiplayer servers, changes how the world fog works to make more of the world visible, and fixes a couple of other bugs.

If you are running a multiplayer server, we highly encourage you to upgrade to this version as soon as possible.

Enjoy!

<https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-18-1>Technical Changes in 1.18.1

Fixed an issue that would cause players on low-bandwidth connections to get timeout errors when connecting to a server

World fog now starts further away from the player, to make distant terrain more visible

Instead of applying fog as a spherical volume it is now applied as a cylindrical volume

<https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-18-1>Fixed bugs in 1.18.1

[MC-152198](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-152198)  - Actual render distance is 2 chunks lower than render distance setting

[MC-219507](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-219507)  - Beacon’s power reverts back to previous one on world reload

[MC-229321](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-229321)  - Bees inside of bee hives / nests sometimes despawn when the world is reloaded

[MC-242729](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-242729)  - “Observer activating without any updates nearby, caused by /clone”

[MC-243216](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-243216)  - Chunk render distance on servers seems shorter than in 1.17.1

[MC-243796](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-243796)  - Random non fatal exceptions in console: Failed to store chunk ConcurrentModificationException

<https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-18-1>Get the Release

​To install the release, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/download) and click play!

Cross-platform server jar:

[Minecraft server jar](https://launcher.mojang.com/v1/objects/125e5adf40c659fd3bce3e66e67a16bb49ecc1b9/server.jar)

Report bugs here:

[Minecraft issue tracker!](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary)

Want to give feedback?

Head over to our  [feedback website](https://feedback.minecraft.net/)  or come chat with us about it on the  [official Minecraft Discord](https://discord.gg/Minecraft) .
translated_content:
我们现已发布 Minecraft: Java 版 1.18.1。此版本修复了一个针对多人服务器的关键安全问题，改进了世界雾效的处理方式，使更多地形可见，并修复了其他一些漏洞。

如果您正在运行多人服务器，我们强烈建议您尽快升级到此版本。

祝使用愉快！

<https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-18-1>1.18.1 的技术变更

修复了一个问题：之前低带宽连接的玩家在尝试连接到服务器时会出现超时错误。

世界雾效现在从玩家更远的位置开始生成，从而让远处的地形更加清晰可见。

雾效不再以球形体积的形式应用，而是改以圆柱形体积的形式应用。

<https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-18-1>修复了1.18.1中的漏洞

[MC-243796](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-243796) - 控制台出现随机非致命异常：尝试存储区块时发生 ConcurrentModificationException 错误

<https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-18-1> 获取最新版本

要安装新版本，请打开 [Minecraft 启动器](https://www.minecraft.net/download)，然后点击 ‘开始游戏’(play)！

跨平台服务器jar文件：

[Minecraft 服务器jar文件](https://launcher.mojang.com/v1/objects/125e5adf40c659fd3bce3e66e67a16bb49ecc1b9/server.jar)

在此处报告漏洞：

[Minecraft 问题跟踪器！](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary)

想要提供反馈吗？

请访问我们的[反馈网站](https://feedback.minecraft.net/)，或在[官方 Minecraft Discord](https://discord.gg/Minecraft)上与我们讨论这些问题。
